feeds.description: Founded in 2015 by working mums Dolores Au and Gidania Wong, Mummyfique started off as a digital destination with intelligent, thoughtful editorial for today's savvy, time-starved modern mothers with babies and young children. Mummyfique is the go-to resource for busy mums filled with parenting tips, travel guides, recipes, toys, fashion, community support and more.
